frame_checksum: raw SHA-256 bytes over uncompressed frame fields 1-9
semantic_digest: schema preamble followed by uncompressed frame fields 1-9 in dataset/site order
invariants: invalid_mask_bytes = ceil(value_count / 8) and unused padding bits are zero
masked values have canonical positive-zero payload
frames are unique and strictly ordered by dataset_order then site_order
site index ranges contain complete frames and the BGZF stream has canonical EOF
